overview_description.description:
Hiration is an AI-powered recruitment marketplace helping job seekers in each step of their job search process. The platform enables users to create, optimize, and manage their professional identities.

The company was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Palo Alto, California.

product.name: Resume Review
product.description: An AI-powered service that evaluates resumes against industry standards and provides feedback to improve their effectiveness.

product.name: Cover Letter Templates
product.description: A collection of professional cover letter templates to help users create tailored cover letters for job applications.

product.name: LinkedIn Profile Review
product.description: A tool that analyzes LinkedIn profiles and provides recommendations to optimize them for better job shortlisting.

product.name: Interview Preparation
product.description: A service providing relevant interview questions and answers based on the user's resume and targeted job role.
